$comment: DEMONSTRATES the four result states of a PageSpeed round and why each exists. 'home' desktop = 'measured': 3 runs (89/91/93), the cell carries the MEDIAN 91 and the median run's LAB metrics + CrUX FIELD data, plus an `evidence` block whose `runScore` (91) is the score INSIDE the linked report — psi-sheet.mjs refuses to publish when it disagrees with `score`, so runScore is REQUIRED. 'home' mobile = 'measured' with score 41 — below 50, so a comment is MANDATORY, and the comment names WHAT is slow (the score never explains itself). 'pricing' desktop = 'not-run': only 1 of the 3 target runs succeeded, so there is NO score and the cell stays EMPTY — a 1-run number would be noise dressed as a fact, and 0 would be a lie. 'pricing' mobile = 'error': every attempt failed, the failure text is kept as evidence. 'legacy-portal' desktop = 'n-a': the page does not exist on that platform in this round — comment mandatory, and again NOT 0. The `budgets` block is what turns numbers into a verdict: it exists ONLY because a named owner approved it on a named date. Without it, this report REPORTS and never JUDGES.
